title: 第3章 赵有容 我想助你修行第4章 凝聚天灵根楚枫屠狗
content_zh:

read2（）;“这怎么可能！”
李供奉瞳孔一震，吓得斧头都慢了半拍。
在他的感知之中，楚枫明明之时炼气境，怎么可能爆发出如此强大的力量。
他刚要收招后退，楚枫已经转身，五指成爪抓住了他的斧柄。
他拼命运转灵力，却发现斧头竟然纹丝不动。
“当年王家追杀你，我爹为了保你，亲自登门给王家主赔罪，你忘了？”
楚枫眼神一凛，周身萦绕天地之力，玄铁斧柄旋转，直接砍下了李供奉的脑袋。
李供奉睁大眼睛，鲜血从脖颈处汩汩涌出。
整个院子瞬间死寂！
张供奉和李供奉都是筑基境，竟然被楚枫秒杀！
赵德柱终于意识到了一丝不对劲，他猛地转头看向赵雪莲，厉声质问。
“这到底是怎么回事，他不是被你抽干纯阳之气，成了废人吗？”
赵雪莲被这声怒吼吓得一哆嗦，她缩着脖子颤声道。
“他把天泉雪莲炼化了，恢复了修为……”
“你这个蠢货！”
赵德柱气得浑身发抖，指着赵雪莲的鼻子破口大骂。
不过，他也看出了端倪。
“大家不要怕，此子不过是突破到了至极境，一刻钟后他周身的天地之力便会消散。”
他们只要困住楚枫一刻钟的时间，此子便在无法嚣张。

闻听此言，众人顿时心中暗暗松了一口气。
“他未必能在一刻钟之内杀光我们所有人。”
“是吗？”
楚枫冷笑一声，而后提起楚雷手中的长剑。
星罗剑网！
一道道红色剑光闪过，众人顿时心中大骇。
“圣阶武技！”
武技分为黄、玄、地、天、圣，他们怎么都想不明白，楚枫怎么可能会圣阶武技！
不过是一个呼吸的功夫，院中血流成河，人头滚滚。
一位年轻人突然跪在了地上，大喊道。
“堂哥，别杀我，我是楚路啊！”
“为了求饶，竟然连堂哥都喊出来了。”
在楚枫眼中，院中没有楚家人，只有赵家的狗。
下一刻，楚路脖颈鲜血飙射，被一剑削首。
十几具尸体横七竖八地躺着，只剩下赵德柱一个人。
赵德柱看着满地尸体，吓得双腿发软。

read2(); "How is this possible!"
Li Gongfeng's pupils were shocked, and he was so frightened that his ax was slowed down by half a beat.
In his perception, how could it be possible for Chu Feng to explode with such powerful power when he was in the Qi Refining State?
Just as he was about to retreat, Chu Feng turned around and grabbed the handle of his axe.
He tried his best to use his spiritual power, but found that the ax did not move at all.
"When the Wang family was chasing you, my father personally came to apologize to the head of the Wang family in order to protect you. Have you forgotten?"
Chu Feng's eyes flashed, the power of heaven and earth lingered around his body, the black iron ax handle rotated, and he directly chopped off Li Gongfeng's head.
Li Gongfeng opened his eyes wide, blood gurgling from his neck.
The entire courtyard was instantly silent!
Zhang Congfeng and Li Congfeng were both in the Foundation Establishment realm, but they were instantly killed by Chu Feng!
Zhao Dezhu finally realized something was wrong. He suddenly turned his head to look at Zhao Xuelian and asked sternly.
"What on earth is going on? Didn't he become a useless person because you drained him of his pure yang energy?"
Zhao Xuelian was frightened by the roar, she shrank her neck and said tremblingly.
"He refined the Tianquan Snow Lotus and restored his cultivation..."
"You idiot!"
Zhao Dezhu was so angry that he was shaking all over, pointing at Zhao Xuelian's nose and yelling.
However, he also saw the clues.
"Don't be afraid, everyone. This child has just reached the extreme level. The power of heaven and earth around him will dissipate in a quarter of an hour."
As long as they trapped Chu Feng for a quarter of an hour, he would no longer be able to act arrogantly.
After hearing this, everyone suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.
"He may not be able to kill us all in a quarter of an hour."
"Really?"
Chu Feng sneered, and then raised the long sword in Chu Lei's hand.
Xingluo Sword Network!
Red sword lights flashed past, and everyone was immediately horrified.
"Holy level martial arts!"
Martial skills are divided into Huang, Xuan, Earth, Heaven, and Saint. They couldn't figure out how Chu Feng could know Saint-level martial arts!
In just one breath, the courtyard was filled with blood and heads.
A young man suddenly knelt on the ground and shouted.
"Cousin, don't kill me, I am Chu Lu!"
"In order to beg for mercy, I even called out my cousin."
In Chu Feng's eyes, there was no Chu family in the courtyard, only the Zhao family's dogs.
The next moment, blood shot out from Chu Lu's neck, and he was decapitated with a sword.
More than a dozen corpses were lying in various directions, and only Zhao Dezhu was left.
Zhao Dezhu looked at the corpses on the ground and his legs became weak with fear.
